stats.notes: Confirmed the score-wrap bug on seed 42 with the 4-token run [down, down, right, right]. Score went 0 -> 100 (coin at (1,3)), then the spikes at (3,3) subtracted 500 and the score showed 65136 instead of flooring at 0. Both runs 4 and 5 show the same symptom. Removing any token breaks the path: a missing down leaves (2,2) as a wall, and a missing right means the spikes are never reached. The coin is required to get a positive score first, so the 4-token list is the shortest reproduction I found. No other bugs were observed in the runs so far (HUD matched state, pause and dialog behaviour looked correct in the earlier runs). Not yet explored: exit and dialog flow, time bonus, the timer at 0, heart and 5-life cap, enemy swap collisions, and the gate/lever mechanics. Finishing now given the budget and the single well-confirmed bug.
